## Checklist
- [ ] `npm run check` passes (build + smoke test + SEO guard)
- [ ] Looked at it at desktop **and** phone width, light **and** dark theme
- [ ] Generated files are committed with their sources (pages, `app.css`, `sw.js`, sitemap, `llms*.txt`, PDFs)
- [ ] Child-facing text is in `assets/js/data/` (no inline Tamil in feature code)
- [ ] Nothing new is stored or sent about a child — or the privacy page is updated
- [ ] Printables rebuilt (`npm run printables`) if their data or design changed
